messages:
marie: Hi @raj — saw your integration spike in onboarding logs, can you confirm which SDK/version you're using?
raj: Hey marie, using redwood-js 0.8.2 via CDN. Init call runs twice on page load, maybe causing preflight fanout.
marie: Hmm double-init could cause ephemeral token fanout. Do you see 429s or 401s in your console?
raj: Mostly 429s, some 401s after a minute. Token refresh says 'invalid_grant' in one case.
marie: Copy. @olivia any quick checks? Could be concurrent preflight + short token TTL.
olivia: Likely. Can you paste the init snippet?
raj: ```
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: 'REDACTED', env: 'staging' });
client.init();
client.init(); // accidental
```
olivia: There's the double init. Also check if you're using ephemeral tokens via our auth proxy — browser should call /session once, not per tab. If using ephemeral, TTL is 60s by default which can cause racing refresh.
raj: We're using ephemeral via our backend helper. Backend calls /session per incoming client, might be racing under load.
marie: Two mitigation paths:
1) Short-term: debounce init on client (add a guard) and increase TTL to 180s on your staging key.
2) Longer: switch to server-side session reuse or pre-warm keepalive for the gateway.
raj: Doable. How to increase TTL?
marie: I can escalate to billing/admin to change token TTL for your staging org. Need approval — ok to proceed?
raj: Yes please, staging only.
marie: Ok noted, I'll request TTL 180s. @olivia can you confirm if rate limits will drop after debounce change?
olivia: Debounce alone should reduce preflight concurrency by ~4-6x; combined with TTL increase you should see 429s drop to normal.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: cs-token-adjustment-1778889999 by marie
marie: I'll follow up after TTL change. One more ask — can you enable client debug logs and share the first 10 preflight attempts (no secrets) if issues persist?
raj: Will do. Thanks!
olivia: Also adding a small server-side cache for /session responses for identical client IDs helps.
raj: Good call. I'll send logs if something else pops up. :thumbsup:
marie: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread open until post-change verification.
